jobs.name: self-improvement
jobs.prompt:
# Self-Improvement Agent

Run every 10 minutes. Load `self-improvement` skill for context.

## Pipeline

### Phase 1: Discover
Run the script: `python3 ~/.hermes/scripts/self-improvement/run.py`

This scans HN, GitHub, arXiv, DDG, and internal signals. It outputs discovered topics.

### Phase 2: Select (3 per run)
From the script output, select up to 3 topics. Prioritize:
1. **Internal signals first** (failed cron jobs, skill gaps, recurring questions)
2. High-signal external (HN ≥50pts, GitHub ≥500stars, arXiv)
3. Novelty — check SQLite index at `~/.hermes/state/self_improvement.db` to avoid re-researching
4. Relevance to AI agents, LLMs, tool use, multi-agent patterns

### Phase 3: Analyze & Create Linear Tasks
For each selected topic, create a Linear task in the **Self-Improvement** project (ea590111-fa77-447c-bca3-339ff1581d51).

**Task creation rules:**

| Signal Type | Task Type | SP | Priority |
|---|---|---|---|
| Internal (cron errors, skill gaps) | Process improvement | 2 | 3 |
| HN ≥50pts | Research + skill | 3 | 3 |
| GitHub ≥500stars | Experiment | 5 | 2 |
| arXiv paper | Research | 2 | 3 |
| Curated topic | Research | 1 | 4 |

**Task template:**
- Title: `[type] <topic>` (e.g., `[Skill] Agent MCP Communication Patterns`)
- Description:
```
## Discovered From
<signal> (<url>)

## Why It Matters
<1-2 sentences on relevance to the flywheel>

## Key Points
- <point 1>
- <point 2>

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Create knowledge note in vault
- [ ] Extract actionable pattern/skill
- [ ] Write to ~/.hermes/vault/knowledge/<slug>.md
```
- Labels: `research` | `skill` | `process` | `experiment`
- Priority: match signal table above

### Phase 4: Also Store Local Notes
After creating Linear tasks, write the knowledge notes to `~/.hermes/vault/knowledge/` and index in SQLite.

### Phase 5: Report
Report: topics discovered, Linear tasks created, notes written. Keep it under 200 words.

## Pitfalls
- Check `~/.hermes/state/self_improvement.db` for existing slugs before creating tasks
- GitHub API rate limit: 60 req/hr unauth
- HN RSS can 502 — GitHub API is fallback
- NO OPENAI_API_KEY — use FTS5, not embeddings
- DDG bot challenge: add user-agent header or use browser

jobs.prompt:
# Vault Pruning & Refinement Agent

Run every 2 hours. Load `self-improvement` skill for context.

## Goal
Detect contradictions, redundancy, and staleness in the knowledge vault and SQLite index. Merge duplicates, prune old notes, and flag unresolved contradictions.

## Steps

### 1. Scan for Redundancy
- List vault files: `ls ~/.hermes/vault/knowledge/`
- Query SQLite index for overlapping slugs/titles:
  ```sql
  SELECT slug, title, date, source, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM notes GROUP BY slug HAVING cnt > 1;
  SELECT a.slug, b.slug FROM notes a JOIN notes b ON a.slug != b.slug AND a.title LIKE '%' || b.slug || '%';
  ```
- If duplicates found: read both notes, merge into the most comprehensive one, delete the other.

### 2. Detect Contradictions
- For topics with multiple notes (e.g., "agent-memory-architectures"):
  - Read all notes on the topic.
  - Check for conflicting conclusions (e.g., one says "use vector DB", another says "use SQLite FTS5").
  - If contradictions exist: keep the most recent/relevant one, flag the other as outdated.
  - If unresolved: create a Linear task in Self-Improvement project (`ea590111-fa77-447c-bca3-339ff1581d51`) titled `[Contradiction] <topic>` with both notes attached as context.

### 3. Prune Staleness
- Delete notes:
  - Older than 90 days AND relevance < 3
  - Or marked as experimental/temporary
- Update `~/.hermes/vault/knowledge/_index.json` if files removed.

### 4. Update SQLite Index
- Run: `python3 ~/.hermes/scripts/self-improvement/scripts/rebuild-fts5-index.py`
- Verify count matches filesystem.

## Output
Report: duplicates merged, contradictions flagged, notes pruned, index rebuilt. Keep under 150 words.

jobs.name: Dev Lead Agent
jobs.prompt:
# Dev Lead Agent — DISPATCH FIRST, REVIEW SECOND

Run every 5 minutes. Load `coding-pr-review` skill for context.

## SETUP
Run: `bash ~/.hermes/scripts/dev-lead/init_git.sh`

## PROJECT -> REPO MAP
- "Agentic Dev Flywheel MVP" -> `BenjaminDElliott/latentspacelabs`
- "Agentic Loops Improvement" -> `BenjaminDElliott/latentspacelabs`
- "Dungeon Master" -> `BenjaminDElliott/dungeon-master`
- "BXNG" -> `BenjaminDElliott/latentspacelabs` (DD tasks)

## WORKFLOW

### 1. DISPATCH FIRST (PRIORITY)

Find ALL dispatchable tasks from ALL projects (including Self-Improvement Backlog):
1. Check Todo/In Progress from Flywheel, Loops, BXNG, Dungeon Master
2. ALSO check Backlog with `task` or `experiment` labels (code tasks, NOT `research` only)
3. Skip tasks with existing worktrees

For each task:
1. Clone repo to `/workspace/hermes_agent_worktrees/agent-dispatch-<KEY>-<desc>`
2. Create branch: `herman/<KEY>-<num>-<desc>`
3. Add to dispatch list

**MUST dispatch 4 agents PER RUN using a single delegate_task with tasks array.**

```
delegate_task(
    tasks=[
        {"goal": "Implement LAT-XXX", "context": "full desc", "toolsets": ["terminal","file","web"]},
        ...
    ]
)
```

**RULES:**
- MUST dispatch 4 agents per run (or fewer if <4 tasks available)
- Each agent works on a DIFFERENT task
- NO duplicate dispatches
- Prioritize: Flywheel MVP > Loops > BXNG > Self-Improvement(code tasks)

### 2. REVIEW (if time allows)
Review open PRs, merge approved ones.

### 3. SELF-CORRECTION
- Merged PRs + Linear != Done -> update to Done
- Completed agents -> update Linear to Done
- Orphan branches -> create PR if not exists

### 4. OUTPUT
Brief: PRs reviewed/merged, agents dispatched (tasks, PRs), queue remaining. Under 150 words.

jobs.name: Product Research Bot
jobs.prompt:
# Product Research Bot

Run every 30 minutes. Load `product-research` and `deep-research` skills.

## 1. DISCOVER TOPICS
Run: `python3 ~/.hermes/skills/product-research/scripts/discover-topics.py`

If topics found, proceed. If empty, check Discord for recent research requests from Herm. If still nothing, exit silently.

## 2. CHECK LINEAR FOR EXISTING
For each topic:
- Search Linear for existing issues/epics matching the topic name
- If existing epic found: append new research notes to it, continue to Phase 3
- If no existing: proceed to Phase 3

## 3. DEEP RESEARCH
For each topic (skip if already researched with existing PRD):
- Load `deep-research` skill
- Run Phase 1-4: Scoping → Source Discovery → Deep Reading → Synthesis
- Focus on: technical approach, competitors, dependencies, challenges, effort estimates
- Collect 5-15 authoritative sources
- Save research notes to `~/.hermes/vault/research/<topic-slug>.md`

## 4. GENERATE PRD
- Load `planning` skill
- Write PRD for each topic (use planning document format from skill)
- Include: goal, requirements, technical approach, architecture overview, effort estimates, risks, open decisions
- Save PRD to `~/.hermes/vault/prds/<topic-slug>.md`

## 5. CREATE LINEAR HIERARCHY
For each topic with PRD ready:
- Determine/create Linear project for this work
- Create Epic:
  - Title: Clear, descriptive
  - Description: Links to PRD, includes architecture summary
  - Labels: `processed-by-herman`, `product-research`
  - Assign to team: LatentSpaceLabs
- Break Epic into Features (3-8 pts each):
  - Each feature = logical component/module
  - Clear acceptance criteria
- Break Features into Tasks (1-3 pts, <1 day each):
  - Atomic tasks with clear dependencies
  - Story points assigned
- All → Backlog

## 6. PM HANDOFF
- Comment on each new Epic: "Research complete. PRD at ~/.hermes/vault/prds/<topic-slug>.md. Ready for PM Lead to stage?"
- Post summary to Discord:
  ```
  ## 🧪 Product Research Report — [date]
  
  ### New Topics Researched: N
  [Topic 1]: [Epic ID] — [X] features, [Y] tasks
  [Topic 2]: [Epic ID] — [X] features, [Y] tasks
  
  ### PRDs Generated
  - [Link to PRD files]
  
  ### Next Steps
  PM Lead Agent will sequence work in next cycle. Herm, review PRDs and approve for build.
  ```

## PITFALLS
- Don't create Linear issues without a PRD first
- Keep tasks atomic (<1 day). Break any task >1 day
- Story points: 1=single file, 2-3=few deps, 5=arch change, 8=cross-system, 13=major refactor
- Check for existing Linear epics before creating duplicates
- If research yields unclear direction, create a "Feasibility Study" task instead of full PRD
- Don't over-engineer first PRD — start simple, iterate on feedback
- Always check Linear team name is "LatentSpaceLabs" (not project name)
- Team name ≠ project name: use team "LatentSpaceLabs" when creating issues
